hero.title: BBS in Italy for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Earn a comprehensive Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) in Italy, integrating core management principles, business economics, quantitative analysis, and corporate strategy. International students build strong business acumen and explore post-study residence permit opportunities for work search under Italian immigration regulations.

highlights.eligibility: Recognised academic qualification + English / Italian proficiency

overview: BBS in Italy for Indian students can be an option for Indian students who wish to build a base in business, management, economics, finance, and entrepreneurship after completing Class 12. Italy's public universities, private universities and business schools all offer undergraduate business and economics degrees.

The term Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) is not consistently used across Italian universities. Similar programs may be known as Business Administration, Economics and Management, International Business or Business and Economics. Before applying, students must check the official title of the degree, course duration, language of instruction and admission requirements.

Students can use the international business environment in Italy, the range of industries and university programs to build knowledge that is relevant to careers in marketing, finance, sales, business development and management.

sections.title: Why Study BBS in Italy?

items: Benefits of Opting for a BBS-Related Course in Italy after Class 12 There are numerous professional and academic benefits of opting for a BBS-related course in Italy after class 12.
International business exposure: Get to know European markets, international trade and global business practices.
Business fundamentals: Learn about management, accounting, economics, marketing and finance.
English-taught options Some Italian universities offer undergraduate business programs taught in English.
Hands-on learning: Depending on the course, students may be expected to complete group projects, case studies, presentations and business assignments.
Specialization options international business finance marketing entrepreneurship and management.
Industry exposure: Many universities provide career services, company projects, networking events and internship opportunities.
Multicultural environment: study with students from different countries and experience Italian culture.
Postgraduate opportunities: Graduates may apply for a Master in Management, International Business, Finance or other relevant field, depending on eligibility.
Students should carefully compare course structures, as a business-related bachelor's degree might not be called exactly the BBS.

3. Top BBS Universities in Italy
Italian universities provide undergraduate courses in business, economics and management for Indian students to consider.
1. Università Bocconi
Bocconi provides bachelor degrees in subjects such as International Economics and Management. These programs are business, economics, management and international markets.
Official site: unibocconi.it
2. Bologna University

The university offers undergraduate degrees in economics and business. Students should consult the current course catalog to find a program that suits their interests and preferred language of instruction.

sections.title: Who can study BBS in Italy?

items: The eligibility criteria for BBS related undergraduate program varies from university to university and course to course.
Common requirements are:
Class 12 qualification: Higher secondary education or equivalent recognized qualification.
Academic Performance: Satisfying the university's minimum academic requirements.
Subject requirements Some economics and business programs will require maths or a suitable quantitative background.
English Language: English taught programs may require IELTS, TOEFL or other accepted qualification subject to university policy.
Some programs require an aptitude test or another kind of admission test (entrance test).
Assessment of qualifications: The university checks whether the applicant meets its entry requirements with their Indian school-leaving qualification.

There is not a minimum percentage of class 12 or English test score that is standard for all the Italian universities. Applicants should check the entry requirements for the course they wish to study.
5. Admission Criteria for BBS in Italy
Undergraduate applicants to study business in Italy may be required to submit:
Mark sheet & certificate of class 10.
Passing certificate and mark sheet of class 12
Valid passport
Proof of English proficiency test (if needed).
Entrance test scores, if any.
Application form online.
Confirmation of application fee payment (if applicable).
Cover letter / personal statement (if required).
Other academic documents required by the university.
Official translations or documents of authenticity where applicable.

Universities may select applicants based on entrance exams and academic records. Other may have additional procedures for evaluation. Requirements differ between public universities, private universities and business schools.

7. Admission Procedure of BBS in Italy
Here are the typical steps for Indian students to apply for a bachelor program in business or management .
Choose your program: Discover Bachelor Degrees in Business Administration, Economics and Management, International Business and related degrees.
Check eligibility: Verify eligibility for Class 12, academic standards, subject prerequisites and language requirements.
Check the entrance exams: Please confirm if the university requires an aptitude test or any other type of assessment.
Prepare documentation: Gather school certificates, mark sheets, passport details and other language test results if required.
Application process: Apply through the official portal of the university before the deadline.
Fill out assessments: Take any entrance exams, interviews or other selection process required.
Get your admissions decision: Please review the offer, tuition fees, payment due dates and enrollment instructions.
Complete all pre-enrolment and visa formalities: Follow the instructions of the university, Universitaly and the relevant Italian consular authority, where applicable.
Full final registration: Finalize your university registration and submit any outstanding required documents.
Universities have varying deadlines and procedures for applications. Students should start early enough to allow time to take tests, prepare documents, receive admission decisions and obtain visas.

sections.title: Recognition of the BBS degree in Italy

items: A bachelor's degree in business or similar discipline from an Italian university recognized by the Italian Ministry of Education can be a basis for further education or employment. But the official name of the degree and its status are important.
Before registering, students should verify:
Is the institution officially recognized in the Italian higher education system?
The formal credential awarded by the program.
What kind of degree (bachelor's qualification, usually called a Laurea or Laurea Triennale).
Length of course and ECTS credits.
Whether the degree is recognized for entry to postgraduate courses.
If there are any additional recognition or equivalence requirements in India or another intended destination.

A degree in Economics and Management may cover many subjects similar to BBS, but it is not necessarily called Bachelor of Business Studies. Students are advised to use the official qualification name when applying for further education or employment.

faq.question: After completing Class 12 in India, can I pursue BBS in Italy?
faq.answer: Yes. Students from India can apply for eligible undergraduate business and management programs after Class 12 provided they meet the university's academic, language and other admission requirements.

faq.question: What is the length of BBS in Italy?
faq.answer: In Italy, a bachelor's degree typically lasts three years and normally equals 180 ECTS credits. Depending on the program chosen, the exact duration varies.

faq.question: How much does it cost to study BBS in Italy?
faq.answer: Tuition depends on the institution. As a rough guide, the cost of some public university programs can be around €1,000-€4,000 per year but private institutions can charge considerably more. Check with the university for the current fee.

faq.question: Is IELTS necessary for BBS in Italy?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. English taught programs may require IELTS, TOEFL or other acceptable proof of proficiency in the English language. Exemptions are based on the university policy.

faq.question: Is it possible to do MBA after BBS in Italy?
faq.answer: Yes. Graduates are eligible to apply for an MBA or other relevant postgraduate business program, subject to meeting the entry requirements. Some traditional MBA programs require professional work experience so recent graduates might also consider a Master's in Management.
